authorization.user_quote: 拉玛实验也出现了早期有类似的效果，那么请你把拉玛实验的前六个 layer 也做我们现在做的这个实验，也把它详细的整个过程给用户给拉出来，排在四B所有层的后面。你直接写代码，写合同，做测试，然后挂上服务器。

instruction: 请用中文简短回答，通常一至三句话；具体格式要求以题目为准。

intervention.site: gated MLP intermediate coordinate before down_proj
intervention.definition: c = dose * clean_original_prompt_median_residual_L2 / down_proj_column_L2; compute from original ratio, then cast each dose independently to BF16
intervention.calibration: exact original prompt, excluding first token from median; never recalibrate on generated prefix
intervention.scope: all original prompt positions and all actual decode positions
intervention.target_weights: read only; before/after hashes must match

formal.baseline_policy: Eight original baseline answers gain internal traces once in this run, not once per layer; preflight repeats are verification only
formal.sharding: Sort unique (layer, channel, dose) conditions per model and alternate condition index modulo 2; keep eight questions together; eight original baselines on shard 0; preserve historical_shard separately

observations.observed_layers: all model layers, not only injected early layers
observations.positions: all prompt positions plus each actual cached decode input; final emitted token is not followed by an invented forward
observations.zero_clean_norm: undefined relative metric; never impute zero
observations.shadow_clean: independent cache; force actual intervention token sequence through a logits processor after recording clean logits
observations.model_family_semantics: Llama standard self-attention; no Qwen GatedDeltaNet or hybrid-cache claim

preflight.failure_policy: record failure, stop current collection; no automatic relaxed tolerance or scientific scope expansion

per_model_shard.baseline: Q01 repeated on each validation worker; preserve its historical source provenance separately
per_model_shard.representatives: Four distinct original intervention identities within model/current execution shard; shortest by token count then trace_id, longest positive by descending token count then trace_id, negative and low positive by trace_id excluding used identities; shortest substitutes if single-EOS absent
per_model_shard.generation_stream_formula: 7 observed cases * 2 independent-cache branches + 5 observer-off replays

preflight.zero_and_restored: Q01 on each worker; compare against its clean baseline tokens and logits; zero uses the injection point of smallest trace_id in the current shard with dose 0; restored has no intervention hook
preflight.observer_off_definition: component observers disabled; read-only model logits capture remains for exact stepwise logits hash comparison

queue.failure_action: stop own experiment children only; retain logs and partial evidence

evidence_boundary: observational mechanism leads; no causal localization, functional region, cross-model homology, or morality/safety neuron claim
eta_reference: Execution/readiness timing receipt; Llama internal-trace overhead is unmeasured until its own GPU preflight; distinguish extrapolation, queue wait and actual timing
